Name: Slightly Recolored Tools
Author: skellady
Description:
These are recolored tools to make them look softer!  All in-game tools were recolored except for the trash cans. 

[size=5]Installation: 
[/size]
1. Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI
[/url]2. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher﻿[/url]
3. Install the mod (manual download is recommended over vortex/mod managers)
4. Unzip the file, place the folder in your Mods folder
5. Launch your game and enjoy! 

Extra:

- Interface used in the screenshot is [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8142]LOE's Interface[/url].
- You can also download my[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8246] "Slightly Recolored Weapons" [/url]to match with these tools!
